Decrypt with a private key

Everything is processed locally in your browser. Your private key and encrypted data are never sent over the network.
Paste the complete result produced by the public-key encryption form. The algorithm is detected automatically.
Encrypted PEM keys are not supported.

Key format:
  • PKCS#8 defines a standard format for storing private keys.
  • PEM is a file format for storing cryptographic keys and certificates.
More information: Public key encryption / decryption
